spec.name: hook_plate
spec.description: Hook plate 120 x 80 x 20 mm, bolted along its top face (y = 80) to a beam, carrying a 1.5 kN hanging load at a lower corner.

supports.note: Top face y = 80 bolted to the beam, modeled as fully fixed.

loads.note: 1.5 kN hanging load (gravity is -y) applied along the through-thickness edge at the lower corner x = 120, y = 0.

assumptions: The brief does not say which lower corner; the corner at x = 120, y = 0 was chosen. The x = 0 corner gives a mirror-image result.
The load is distributed across the full 20 mm thickness at that corner edge.
Bolted top face is treated as a fully clamped face.
